scope: Read-only source review and eight pure-function/small ordinary-file reproductions; no main/controller/benchmark/build/VM/AMFI/mount/process inspection executed
test_semantics: InitialBoundaryReproductions intentionally confirms malformed inputs accepted; not acceptance success. Invert regressions after fixes.

blockers.issue: No process timeout or own-group cleanup/reap; hang can retain Task8 directory lock and omit failure record
elapsed_seconds NaN/negative/inconsistent accepted; exact types, finite duration, ns correspondence, independently expected offsets and RSS schema required
Comparison need not descend from measured helper; SHA role distribution and comparison call-count/readsize relation not validated
Variant names/binary SHA do not enforce common actual test source/build flags or trace/readsize matrix; wrapper command/env/guard/timeout/child PID relation not validated
No isolated artifact root lock, VM /tmp argv alias missing; Package writing follows symlink/hardlink and occurs before metadata output reservation

positive_findings: Fresh per-label trace prefix and exact trace/sample PID are checked
analyze-trace validates terminal completeness and parent/thread intervals
SHA actual bytes and comparison logical bytes/blocks are checked
Warmup rows are excluded and first three measured rounds use Latin rotation
Summary uses measured helper elapsed seconds and comparison spans; no inclusive CLI total invented
Benchmark source dd17 ends helper clock before result checks, and uses synthetic materialized files only
